I have been farming these 9 mu in Quzhou for 30 years. I never went to school, but I know my land. Last year I did the same thing I always do, and it worked out fine, so I will do it again this year.

I have 9 mu total. I split it into two pieces. On 5.5 mu I do wheat in the winter and then maize right after. On 3.5 mu I grow cotton. That is what my neighbors do, and I copy them. If I changed something and it failed, I would lose money I cannot afford to lose.

**Wheat:** My 5.5 mu of winter wheat is already in the ground. I sowed 30 jin of improved seed per mu — the kind from the seed shop, I buy it every year. Last year I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing, and I will topdress with urea in the spring when the wheat turns green. All together that is about 38 jin of nitrogen, 22 jin of phosphate, and 10 jin of potash per mu. I irrigate four times: once in winter and three more times before harvest. The well water is good. I spray pesticide three times — twice for bugs and once for weeds. I rotary till every year. If the weather is normal I should get about 1,100 jin per mu.

**Maize:** After I cut the wheat in June, I plant hybrid maize seed on the same 5.5 mu. I buy Denghai 605 or whatever hybrid the dealer has — 1.2 bags per mu. I do not till the soil, I just plant directly into the wheat stubble. Maize does not need as much fertilizer as wheat. I put about 25 jin nitrogen, 8 jin phosphate, and 8 jin potash per mu. I irrigate twice, that is enough. Pesticide three times total. If it rains well I should get about 1,100 jin per mu, same as last year.

**Cotton:** My 3.5 mu of cotton is my main crop. I rotary till in spring and lay plastic film. I buy improved cotton seed — 3 jin per mu. Cotton needs more fertilizer than people think, and I would rather put a bit too much than watch the bolls fall off. I use about 25 jin nitrogen, 18 jin phosphate, and 16 jin potash per mu. I irrigate twice, once at flowering and once at boll stage. But the real work is spraying. I spray 14 times in total — 13 times for bollworm and aphids, and once for weeds. If I skip even one spray, the worms will eat everything. I expect about 550 jin of seed cotton per mu. The price was good last year, so I hope it stays.

My sons work in the city and send some money home, but the farm is what feeds us. Every jin of fertilizer costs real money. I spend about 1,500 yuan on fertilizer for the whole farm, plus another 800 yuan on pesticide, mostly for the cotton. I could buy less, but if the yield drops, my family suffers. I watch what Old Wang and Old Li do — they use about the same amounts as me. If everyone around you does something, there is usually a reason.
